partners.mechanism_chain: RDH12 (HGNC:9904) —DISRUPTS→ Retinoid Cycle Intermediates (REACT:R-HSA-1643896); Retinoid Cycle Intermediates (REACT:R-HSA-1643896) —LEADS_TO→ Retinal Dystrophy (HP:0000500); RHO (HGNC:9964) —DISRUPTS→ Phototransduction Cascade (REACT:R-HSA-2174805); Phototransduction Cascade (REACT:R-HSA-2174805) —LEADS_TO→ Retinitis Pigmentosa (HP:0000598); Retinoid Cycle Intermediates (REACT:R-HSA-1643896) —BINDS→ Phototransduction Cascade (REACT:R-HSA-2174805). Loss-of-function mutations in RDH12 impair the retinoid cycle, leading to accumulation of toxic intermediates and subsequent retinal dystrophy. Concurrently, mutations in RHO disrupt the phototransduction cascade, directly causing retinitis pigmentosa. The shared convergence is on the overall health and function of the retinal photoreceptor cells, where both pathways are critical for visual processing and survival. Impaired retinoid processing (n2) can indirectly impact the efficiency and stability of the phototransduction cascade (n5), creating a common endpoint of photoreceptor degeneration.
